designToolRouterReason: This contour adds a pure derived list and keyboard parity contract over manual map graph and transient ViewState/ListState. It creates no product UI surface, visual composition, layout, palette, typography, or Design OS contribution.

commandPlane.capabilityRevalidation: No command is introduced. Keyboard activation emits the same transient selection intents as graph/list selection and relies on the existing ViewState reducer.

implementedBoundary.rowReachability: valid graph nodes and valid graph edges only

checks.command: node --check src/derived/mindmap/manualMapListKeyboardParity.mjs && node --check src/derived/mindmap/index.mjs && node --check src/derived/index.mjs && node --test test/contracts/yalken-atlas-v5-e02b-c03-selection-keyboard-list-parity.contract.test.js test/contracts/yalken-atlas-v5-e02b-c02-viewport-virtualization-lod-planner.contract.test.js test/contracts/yalken-atlas-v5-e02b-c01-graph-interaction-viewstate-boundary.contract.test.js

negativeChecks: corrupt edges are not exposed as reachable list rows
keyboard navigation changes only transient listState
keyboard activation emits the same selection intent semantics as pointer/list selection
Escape clears selection through the existing ViewState reducer while preserving focus
list parity modules have no filesystem, network, Electron, Worker, timers, renderer storage, UI command dispatch, or hot-path event listener bypass
